questions.q: How much more time does a very cluttered household take to manage?
questions.why: The clutter lesson states it takes up to 50 percent more time.

questions.q: How many positive actions correct one negative one in a relationship?
questions.why: The relationships lesson says it takes about five positive actions to correct one negative.

questions.q: According to Gretchen, what is the relationship between money and happiness?
a: It does not guarantee happiness but not worrying about it eases life
More money always leads to proportionally more happiness
Money is the single biggest factor in overall well-being
Money has absolutely no effect on a person's happiness
questions.why: The money lesson paraphrases Gretchen's view that money does not guarantee happiness but removes worry.

questions.q: What is one of Gretchen's principles for happier relationships?
a: You cannot change your partner, only yourself
You should change your partner to better fit your needs
You must always voice every feeling immediately
You should end any relationship that causes even minor pain
questions.why: The relationships lesson lists this as the first of two principles.
